mods.name: Tim (Trail Investigator Module)
mods.description: A Meteor Client addon built with AI featuring a handful of utilities for hunting.

releases.notes:
The "Hunting Utilities" addon is officially Tim (Trail Investigator Module). This update adds new modules, streamlined settings, and QoL improvements.

- Skipper 
*Nether exploration tool utilizing XaeroPlus integration to detect 1.12-to-1.19 highway crossovers and render styled ghost portals with GLOW, PULSE, or SPECTRAL modes. It features multi-era vertical lava column highlighting and manual control via a customizable dismiss key. Prioritizing manual play with zero HUD clutter, Skipper filters sites using strict trail thickness raycasting, lava-flow settle checks, minimum spacing, idle hold delays, and re-entry exemptions.*
